[[File:Cadoan.png|right|thumb|250px|Engagement with Clan Banisa.]]
{{Quote|Nu Mou town. The seat of knowledge and alchemy.|Description}}
'''Cadoan''' {{j|砂漠の都カドアン|Sabaku no To Kadoan|Desert Capital Cadoan}} is the [[nu mou]] [[town]] from ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. Cadoan is home to one of the most useful characters, as well as the usual Pub and Shop. It is the site of "Mission #006: Antilaws", "Mission #056: New Antilaw", "Mission #062: Oasis Frogs", "Mission #074: Cadoan Watch", and "Mission #106: Resistance". The [[Clan]] "Blue Geniuses" from the Clan League also spawn from this location.

==Locations==
===The Sleeping Frog===
The Sleeping Frog is the name of the pub in Cadoan. It is located near an oasis where frogs can be heard croaking. Here, the pub rumors can be read and missions can be accepted or canceled.

===Oasis Armory===
The Oasis Armory is the name of the local shop in Cadoan. Here, discounts are given on weaponry wielded by nu mou.

Discounts are given on:
*Instruments ([[Beastmaster (Tactics Advance)|Beastmaster]])
*Staves ([[White Mage (Tactics Advance)|White Mage]])
*Rods ([[Black Mage (Tactics Advance)|Black Mage]]/[[Illusionist (Tactics Advance)|Illusionist]]/[[Time Mage (Tactics Advance)|Time Mage]])
*Maces ([[Sage (Tactics Advance)|Sage]]/[[Alchemist (Tactics Advance)|Alchemist]])

===Ezel Berbier's Underground Card Shop===
[[File:EzelCardShop.png|right|200px|thumb|Ezel's card shop.]]
{{Quote|Victory over the law is just a trade away!|Famous motto of Ezel's card shop.}}
After completion of "Mission #006 Antilaws", [[Clan Nutsy]] can come here to trade the law cards they are carrying for better, or at least more useful, law cards for use in battle.

Between battles, different events occur in the world that influence the rates that cards are being traded for. Good events, like [[Ezel Berbier|Ezel]] perfecting his techniques, bring half the rate that cards trade for. Bad events, such as a [[Judge (Tactics Advance)|Judge]] crackdown or finals in the Magic Academy, double the rate that cards go for.

The rate that cards go for are usually double the rank that the law card implements or nullifies. R# Antilaws go for 24 points.

==Liberation of Cadoan==
Cadoan is liberated after completing "Mission #075 Free Cadoan!", which becomes available after completing "#074 Cadoan Watch". Freeing Cadoan is rather simple as the opposition in this battle are simply two [[Mog Knight]]s. The player is allowed four units against them, which allows a land-slide victory.

After freeing Cadoan and [[Baguba Port]], a series of missions involving the Falgabirds and the foreign organization The Redwings is unlocked. Completing them unlocks the "ForeignFiends" strand of missions and also "[[Muscadet|#082 Free Muscadet]]".
